why: In `@double/helper.m`, a method of MATLAB's own class `double` (no class `double` in the project), `x` is the method's own object (MATLAB doc 'Methods in Separate Files'), so `feval('tidy', x)` and `f = @tidy; f(x)` dispatch to `@double/tidy.m` before the root `tidy.m` (doc 'feval', 'Function Precedence Order': object functions before the path), as `tidy(x)` does.
